title: Model Run
description: Record of a single model's execution in a given round. Tracks status, attempts, and file references.

model_account.description: Model account name, e.g. chatgpt, deepseek, kimi.

seat_id.description: Seat identifier in the pool, usually matches model_account.

run_marker.description: Unique run marker injected into the prompt. Outputs without matching marker MUST NOT enter consensus. Format: AI_JUDGE_RUN_MARKER:<LABEL>_<ROUND>_<DATE>.

attempt_no.description: Attempt number. Starts at 1. Reruns increment this.

eligible_for_consensus.description: Whether this run's output can be included in consensus calculations.

needs_rerun.description: Whether this model needs to be rerun.

failure_reason.description: Human-readable reason if status is a failure state.

trace_id.description: Identifier for tracing the model execution (e.g. browser session ID, API call ID).

prompt_path.description: File path to the prompt used for this run.

raw_output_path.description: File path to the raw model output.

parsed_output_path.description: File path to the parsed/validated output.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this run was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this run was last updated.
